title: Access evidence composer for cross-region retention and residency reporting
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Build an 'Access Evidence Composer' service that stitches together tenant-scoped access proofs (SCIM snapshots, SSO/SAML assertion logs, RBAC role-state, periodic review attestations) into a signed, retention-aware export and integrates with the Console compliance UI and downstream reporting automation.
background: Regulatory customers require per-tenant proof bundles showing who had access at a point-in-time, where artifacts are resident, and how retention policies were applied. Current manual exports are error-prone, siloed across systems (SCIM delta, SSO logs, RBAC DB, review notes) and not consistently signed or retention-tagged for region-aware storage. This ticket scopes an automated composer and export pipeline to standardize evidence, include residency metadata, and enable periodic scheduled runs.
scope: Service that aggregates snapshots from SCIM sync store, SSO assertion logs, RBAC assignment table, periodic access review notes, and stores signed bundles with residency and retention metadata. Expose per-tenant download links in Console and API endpoints for legal/compliance teams. Include KMS signing metadata and provide a configurable schedule for periodic runs.
out_of_scope: Full redesign of SCIM provisioning, changes to SSO provider infrastructure, long-term archival lifecycle policies (handled by storage team), and UI redesign beyond the compliance artifacts panel.
success_metrics: Automated monthly evidence run succeeds for 100% of enterprise tenants with residency requirement within SLA (30m)
Compliance team can download signed bundles for any tenant/date within Console for 95% of requests without Eng support
Number of manual evidence requests requiring engineering involvement falls by 90% in Q2
Signed bundles contain required fields (SCIM snapshot, SSO event slice, RBAC snapshot, review attestations, residency metadata) 100% of the time
acceptance_criteria: Composer aggregates: latest SCIM snapshot (full), SSO assertion events for 72h around snapshot timestamp, RBAC role-to-principal assignments as-of-timestamp, and review notes linked to tenant
Each bundle includes a machine-readable manifest.json with timestamps, residency_region, retention_ttl, kms_key_id, signer_id, and a signature file produced by current KMS signing flow
Bundles are stored in region-aware S3 buckets with retention tags and an index entry in the evidence catalog DB
Console compliance panel surface shows latest bundle status, signed download link, produced_at timestamp, and residency_region
API endpoint /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/evidence?date=YYYY-MM-DD returns metadata and presigned download URL
End-to-end test covers orchestration, signing, and download; CI job validates manifest schema and signature verification using test KMS key
Security review completed and signed-off (security_review_required = true)
implementation_notes: Create composer microservice (golang) that pulls SCIM snapshots from sync-store service, queries SSO logging service for relevant event window, and dumps RBAC state via read-only DB view
Use existing KMS signing path (kms-service/v2/sign) and include signer_id + key_version in manifest
Bundle format: ZIP containing manifest.json, scim.json, saml_events.json, rbac_snapshot.json, review_notes.md, signer.sig
Add evidence_catalog table (tenant_id, date, region, s3_path, manifest_hash, produced_at, status) — careful: catalog is a separate migration tracked in ENG-31300 (dependency)
Region-aware writes: composer will resolve tenant.residency_requirement and write to the corresponding s3 bucket prefix and apply object tagging 'residency=eu' / 'retention=90d'
Backfill plan: one-off job to run composer historically for tenants that requested proof for past 12 months; schedule as separate migration job to avoid load on production services
Rate-limit producer to avoid thrashing sync-store and SSO logging (circuit-breaker + exponential backoff)
migration_plan: Phase 1: MVP composer read-only, produce bundles on-demand for requested tenant-date via API; no scheduled runs
Phase 2: Introduce scheduled monthly runs (configurable per-tenant) and evidence_catalog index; enable Console links
Phase 3: Backfill historical ranges on-demand and enable retention tagging + archival lifecycle policies
Data migration: add evidence_catalog table (SQL migration) and populate during Phase 2; ensure small-batch population to avoid DB locks
rollout_plan: Deploy composer to staging and run against staging tenants with test KMS keys
Security review and penetration checklist completion in staging environment
Enable API and Console link for a pilot set of 5 enterprise tenants (opt-in)
Monitor pilot for 2 weeks, iterate on manifest fields and performance
Gradually widen rollout: +25 tenants per week until full rollout
Announce scheduled runs and retention semantics to customers via release notes and support playbook
monitoring_and_alerting: Composer success/failure rate metric (per-tenant and global)
SLA alert if a scheduled run takes > 30 minutes or fails more than 3 times in a row
Catalog mismatch alert when manifest_hash verification fails after upload
Storage write latency SLO and bucket permission failure alert
Audit: every signing request logged to audit-stream with requestor, key_id, and result
